title: make build-go names a fork's images codesweep-ai
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach installs (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)
details: `Makefile's IMAGE_OWNER` reads the owner from origin with `[@/]github\.com[:/]`, which needs a `:` or `/` right after `github.com`. An SSH host alias such as `git@github.com-fork:forker/sandbox.git`, which a fork's clones use, does not match. The build then falls back to `codesweep-ai`, so a fork's binary names its images under this project's name.
